key_findings: cache and first batch input/target hashes match across machines, but initial model parameter hash differs before forward/backward.
initial state differs only in tied embedding/lm_head and one Flash-VQG quantizer codebook tensor.
TokenEmbeddings CPU init hash matches across machines, while CUDA init hash differs between 2080ti and 3090 under the same seed.
Therefore canonical cache does not guarantee cross-machine identical training because current model init is GPU-local.
recommended_next_step: Run an init-lock probe by constructing initial tensors on CPU or transplanting a saved init state, then rerun early-step hash comparison before any full-epoch experiment.
